svg.aria-label: Locator map of Lycia, on the southwest coast of Asia Minor (modern Turkey), marking Patara, St Nicholas's birthplace, and Myra, modern Demre, where he was bishop, about 60 km (37 miles) to the east, with the island of Rhodes to the west. A small inset of the eastern Mediterranean shows where Lycia lies in relation to Greece, Constantinople and Cyprus.

g.text: now Demre: where he was bishop
